newsitem.title: UK: UK on course to hit inflation target-government.
newsitem.headline: UK on course to hit inflation target-government.

text.p: Britain is on course to meet its 2.5 percent inflation target, a Downing Street spokesman said on Thursday.
"We are on course to meet our targets as forecast by the Chancellor of the Exchequer on inflation. The economy is in good shape and we are doing very well indeed," he told PA News.
Official figures released earlier on Thursday showed the underlying annual inflation rate, the target measure, was unchanged at 3.1 percent in January compared with the previous month.
City economists expected a small fall to 3.0 percent.
